integration: tools/parity-corpus.sh uses manifest.json profiles; this catalog holds source-known questions.
status: Recipe integration only; availability and observed evidence belong to each generated run inventory

provenance.origin: Original Rampage-owned workloads authored for Phase 0.1; no third-party source copied or fetched
provenance.runtime_licenses: Compiler runtimes, standard libraries and SDKs have separate licenses; outputs stay local

recipe_conventions.out: Fresh caller-owned directory under target/parity; script creates profile subdirectories
recipe_conventions.eval: RAMPAGE_EVAL selects an existing rampage-eval executable; never built by the recipe
recipe_conventions.execution: Compiler invocations only; never execute the resulting programs
recipe_conventions.environment: Script supplies the offline Go environment; flags are argv arrays, never shell-evaluated
recipe_conventions.reproducibility: Run inventory records argv, explicit environment overrides, versions and source/output hashes
recipe_conventions.pairing: Compile once, strip a copy without relinking, then inspect both headers and verify byte pairing
recipe_conventions.expected: Architecture, format and output paths are requested intent, never observed success or function truth

limits: Only a generated run may establish availability after builds, matching headers, stripping and nonempty truth
ELF stripping uses rampage-eval strip; Go pclntab may remain as intentional runtime metadata
Mach-O stripping requires an explicit working tool selected by parent; no strip success claimed
Zero-sized Mach-O function symbols are not sized-symbol truth; keep metric slices unavailable if empty
Debug data or sibling dSYM presence does not establish that the current evaluator can extract truth
No CFG, call-graph, virtual dispatch, exception-edge or decompiler coverage has been measured

programs.workload: In-memory scaled ledger with virtual calls through two bases and RAII rollback on two throws
programs.bounds: Five fixed commands, units at most 20, factor 2 or 3, limit 40; no target I/O

source_known_questions.question: Which two bases does Ledger inherit and which helper dispatches through each?
With argc=1, what state survives both exception paths and what reaches the sinks?
What restores total after capacity and insufficient-unit throws?
source_known_questions.answer: Transaction::~Transaction restores saved_ and increments rollbacks_ unless committed_

programs.workload: Config parsing, command decoding, bounded state transitions, checkpoint/restore and error wrapping
programs.bounds: Config and each command at most 96 bytes; at most 16 commands; units 0..10000; no target I/O

source_known_questions.question: Which commands are accepted and which fields are required in config?
What state reaches parityGoState with no extra command-line arguments?
Does a rejected over-limit add mutate total or applied?
source_known_questions.answer: No; applyCommand validates next before assigning total or incrementing applied

programs.workload: Result pipeline, Option checkpoint, two Operation trait implementations and rejected commands
programs.bounds: Config and each command at most 96 bytes; at most 16 commands; units 0..10000; no target I/O

source_known_questions.question: Which implementations dispatch through Operation and how do their candidates differ?
source_known_questions.answer: Add computes total + units * factor; Remove computes total - units * factor

source_known_questions.question: What state reaches black_box on the no-argument success path?
What does restore before checkpoint return and how does the pipeline handle it?
source_known_questions.answer: MissingCheckpoint; run_pipeline increments rejected and continues without mutating total/applied
